## Combo 1938-1971-3086
Cards: Yannik, Scavenging Sentinel + Glorious Protector + Lagrella, the Magpie
Color identity: GWU | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 170 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Yannik, Scavenging Sentinel (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Lagrella, the Magpie (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
  When Yannik enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Lagrella enters, it exiles Yannik until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
  When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Lagrella until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).
